Stats Xente User Script

By xente (MA) - 10-08-2024 12:39


[FGALMZ]
President
Hello everyone,

I have made a small script to embed many of the statistical data that is on my website on the Managerzone page itself, many of them are useful to compare your value against other rivals.

I leave you some screenshots:

Leagues pages



You can check the values ​​of the teams, the value of the team is its last game played and the ELO score (an original idea by user bebben) that many use to compare their potential against other users.

If you click in the buttons you can see stats grapsh and more of the teams or league:



Same for clash leagues:



And you can make a full compare in the current clash:





A summary of skills by tactic or age categories on the players page:




Comparison of National Teams in the country ranking (help in the events of the World Cup or similar):



Additionally, if you play a competition based on friendlies on the web, you will be able to see your next matches on the main page:



--------------------------------------------------------------------------------

INSTALLATION

The first time you run it, these two screens will appear, click on always allow domains, the only thing it does is allow the script to connect to my website and the Managerzone website to obtain the data.




Link: https://greasyfork.org/es/scripts/491442-stats-xente-script

If you need help on installation or use please let me know.

I would like to thank my hockey Spain colleagues for their help and suggestions, as well as two of my best web users, gordola and walterojo, for their feedback.

If you have multiple user scripts it is likely that they may conflict with each other, you can disable the script functions as you prefer to see the things that are most important to you.

Enjoy!

Telegram BOT

@stats_xente_transfers_bot
